magic-item:helmsman-s-shelter.description: While held it grants +1 AC beyond its normal bonus, and while attuned +1 to checks to pilot waterborne vehicles. It has 5 charges, all regained at dawn: expend 3 to cast Control Water (DC 15), or 1 as a Magic action to seize a ruddered vessel within 300 feet (its helmsman makes a DC 15 Strength save to resist), turning it up to 90 degrees until your next turn.

magic-item:hexaxe.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a warlock; handaxe
magic-item:hexaxe.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon against creatures affected by a Concentration warlock spell you cast. It has 3 charges, all regained at dusk; as a Reaction when you make a Concentration save for a warlock spell while holding it, expend 1 to add your Charisma modifier (minimum +1).

magic-item:hurricane-lance.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn: as a Magic action expend 1 to wrap yourself in wind for 1 minute, letting you Disengage as a Bonus Action, and expend another to extend it to your mount (ends if Unconscious or not holding the lance). Once per dawn, cast Thunderwave at level 3 (DC 16).

magic-item:ice-sickle.description: It deals an extra 1d6 Cold damage to the first target it hits on each of your turns.

magic-item:immovable-button.description: As a Bonus Action with the word "hold," it fixes itself to unworn fabric (or a willing wearer's) in place for 1 minute, holding up to 500 pounds without tearing; a DC 20 Athletics check moves it 10 feet. A DC 10 Investigation check identifies its magic. It is used up afterward.

magic-item:infernal-aegis.description: As a Bonus Action with a command word it is wreathed in harmless flame (Bright Light 20 feet, Dim 20 more). While held it grants Fire Resistance and +1 AC beyond its normal bonus. It has 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn; while ablaze, cast Fire Shield (warm, 2) or Hellish Rebuke (1, DC 16).

magic-item:inferno-rope.description: Once per dawn, as a Magic action lay it down and ignite it into a 10-foot-long, 15-foot-tall wall of fire for 1 minute (Bright Light 15 feet, Dim 15 more). Creatures within 5 feet when lit, entering it for the first time on a turn, or ending a turn in it make a DC 13 Dexterity save or take 2d4 Fire damage. It breaks only to magic, becoming nonmagical.

magic-item:ionbreaker-the-tempest-s-reac.description: You gain a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Add 1d10 to Initiative while carrying it. When you Attack, make one bow attack as a Bonus Action. After a ranged hit on your turn, the target and creatures within 5 feet take 1d8 Lightning damage (once per creature per round). Targets hit become conduits for 1 minute; as a Bonus Action, electrify conduits within 60 feet: Lines arc between those within 30 feet of each other, each conduit takes 2d8 Lightning, and others in a Line make a DC 18 Dexterity save for 2d8 or half. Once per turn on a miss, reroll against another target within 30 feet with Disadvantage. You have a hovering Fly Speed equal to your Speed within 20 feet of the ground. When you take Lightning damage, roll 1d8 for a chaotic storm effect. It has 1 minor and 1 major beneficial and 1 minor and 1 major detrimental random property and can be destroyed only in the Stormheart.

magic-item:ironleaf-maul-of-entanglement.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn. Right after hitting a Medium or smaller target, expend 1: it makes a Strength save (DC 8 + your Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus) or takes 1d6 Piercing damage and is Restrained until the end of its next turn.

magic-item:ironleaf-oaken-shield.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a druid; shield
magic-item:ironleaf-oaken-shield.description: While held it grants +1 AC beyond its normal bonus. When you transform into a Beast while holding it, it latches onto your new form for +1 AC and returns to your arm when you revert.

magic-item:ironleaf-plate.description: While wearing it you gain a +1 bonus to AC, have no Stealth Disadvantage, and have Bludgeoning Resistance; Fire damage withers the vines, suppressing these for 1 minute. Once per dawn, cast Pass without Trace from it.

magic-item:ironshod-trotters.description: Dash grants 10 extra feet. Once per dawn, click them to Polymorph yourself into a Riding Horse for 8 hours, keeping your mental scores and skill and save proficiencies, with bags draped as saddlebags; any damage ends it and applies to your normal form.

magic-item:jotun-s-jodhpurs.description: While wearing them and not in Heavy armor, you count as one size smaller when riding a non-Humanoid mount.

magic-item:killskull-longbow-of-dread.description: It holds up to 4 charges, gaining 1 when it reduces a Small or larger creature to 0 Hit Points. On a ranged hit, expend 1 for an extra 1d8 Psychic damage; the target makes a DC 15 Wisdom save or is Frightened for 1 minute (save ends at end of each turn).

magic-item:kindle-egg-sugarbomb.description: Eaten as a Magic action, it grants Fire Resistance and tolerance to temperatures down to -50 degrees Fahrenheit for 1 hour. Upset Stomach: only one such sugarbomb works at a time; eating another replaces it and forces a DC 13 Constitution save or you're Poisoned for 1 minute.

magic-item:knight-s-standard-of-valor.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. You and allies within 10 feet add Proficiency Bonus to saves against Frightened, and allies starting their turn within 10 feet gain +5 Speed that turn. You can restyle its flag over 1 hour (doable during a Short Rest).

magic-item:knight-s-standard-of-vigor.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. You and allies within 10 feet add Proficiency Bonus to saves against Poisoned, and as a Reaction when such an ally regains Hit Points from a spell or potion in combat, it regains an extra 1d6 + 2. You can restyle its flag over 1 hour (doable during a Short Rest).

magic-item:knight-s-standard-of-virtue.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. You and allies within 10 feet add Proficiency Bonus to saves against Charmed, and as a Reaction when an ally you can see within 10 feet takes damage, reduce it by 5 and take that much Force damage yourself. You can restyle its flag over 1 hour (doable during a Short Rest).

magic-item:knocking-boots.description: Once per dawn, kick a locked or barred object to cast Knock on it.

magic-item:kraken-s-whip.description: As a Magic action, a Large or smaller creature within 10 feet makes a DC 13 Strength or Dexterity save or is Grappled and takes 1d4 + 2 Bludgeoning damage, repeating that damage at the end of each of its turns; escape takes an action and a DC 13 Athletics check. You can't attack with it while grappling, can release freely, and drag the creature (at double movement cost unless it's much smaller) if you move more than 10 feet away.

magic-item:lance-of-the-hungering-dead.description: The first time each turn you hit a living enemy with a melee attack, it takes an extra 1d12 Necrotic damage and you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to half (rounded up).

magic-item:leeching-quarterstaff.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 6 charges, regaining 1d6 at dawn. On a hit, expend 1 for an extra 1d6 Necrotic damage, regaining that many Hit Points (not against Undead or Constructs).

magic-item:liar-s-lyre.description: You're proficient with it while attuned. You have Advantage on Deception checks after at least 1 minute spent selling a lie, and Vicious Mockery cast while holding it gets +1 to its save DC.

magic-item:lightning-pylons.description: A set of three 3-foot rods, each with one charge (12 hours to recharge). Plant one within 5 feet as a Magic action; as a Bonus Action electrify a charged pylon within 5 feet for 1 minute, linking to charged pylons within 20 feet (up to six) with 10-foot-tall opaque walls of lightning (Bright Light 10 feet, Dim 10 more). Creatures in a wall when it appears, entering it, or ending a turn within 5 feet make a DC 15 Dexterity save (Disadvantage if metal or in metal armor): 5d8 Lightning damage and Speed 0 until their next turn, or half damage and half Speed. Pylons have AC 15, 20 Hit Points, Immunity to Poison and Psychic; touching one or hitting it with metal deals 1d8 Lightning per linked pylon. A destroyed pylon is unusable for 2 days.

magic-item:locksmith-s-bane.description: +3 to Sleight of Hand checks to pick locks with it. On a natural 1 it casts Knock on the lock and crumbles; if you reroll or alter that 1, it just becomes nonmagical.

magic-item:love-s-embrace.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Two allies can attune together over a Long Rest, raising it to +2. As a Bonus Action it splits into two scimitars or rejoins, and can summon itself or its halves to your hand on the same plane. Separated, the scimitars are Thrown (20/60, Piercing) and deal an extra 1d6 Cold or 1d6 Fire damage respectively; joined, the greatsword deals both. It can cast Fire Shield twice per dawn, once per attuned creature per day.

magic-item:mageplate-cap.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a sorcerer or wizard
magic-item:mageplate-cap.description: It has 2 charges, regaining 1 at dawn; expend 1 to cast Mage Armor on yourself as platelike force, making your base AC 15 + your Dexterity modifier.

magic-item:magma-war-pick.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 1d4 Fire damage. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; on a hit against a metal target or one in metal armor, expend 1 for an extra 2d8 Fire damage.

magic-item:mammoth-boots.description: While wearing them you weigh 50 pounds more, ice and snow Difficult Terrain costs no extra movement, and forced movement against you is reduced by 5 feet.

magic-item:mantle-of-the-pack-lord.description: While wearing it, creatures don't gain Advantage on attacks against you from having an ally within 5 feet of you (such as Pack Tactics).

magic-item:mask-of-dendallen.description: It has 5 charges, all regained at dusk: cast Bestow Curse, Fear, Speak with Dead, or Tongues (DC 16), with Advantage on Concentration saves for them. You understand any written language you see. Curse: on first wearing make a DC 16 Intelligence save or take 5d10 Psychic damage and be unable to remove it without Remove Curse; you can't smell or taste (failing such Perception checks), take 1d10 Psychic damage on any natural 1 on a D20 Test, and your voice changes (roll 1d6); your face recovers 1d4 days after removal.

magic-item:mask-of-the-pact-bearer.description: It takes your patron's visage. Once per dawn, cast one spell from your level 3 warlock subclass spell list of a level up to your warlock slot level, without a slot, at its lowest level.

magic-item:master-machinist-s-marvelous-.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 7 charges, regaining 1d6 + 1 at dawn: expend 1 to cast Mending on an area up to 5 feet on a side, or 3 as a Bonus Action to enchant a creature's armor for +1 AC for 1 minute (one such enchantment per creature).

magic-item:mastery-gem.description: An indestructible gem. Held against a non-legendary, non-artifact item whose attunement requirement you don't meet, it fuses to it and lets you attune anyway. You can end that attunement normally even if the item is cursed, breaking the curse on you; the gem then detaches, leaving the item nonmagical.

magic-item:memento-of-the-shapeless.attunementNote: Any melee weapon without Heavy or Reach
magic-item:memento-of-the-shapeless.description: Forged from an ancient mimic. You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. As a Bonus Action it reshapes into any melee weapon you're proficient with that lacks Heavy and Reach. On a hit you can grapple the target (DC 13 Strength save), and can't attack another while holding it. Once per 12 hours, as a Magic action, stretch it as a pseudopod to attack a creature within 30 feet, ignoring Half and Three-Quarters Cover, for 6d8 Bludgeoning damage; if you also grapple, the DC is 15 and a failed save pulls it 15 feet closer (30 feet and still Grappled if it fails by 5 or more). It can replace a missing arm, adding your Proficiency Bonus to Athletics checks with it (doubled if proficient).

magic-item:merry-berry.description: Raw, it tastes like shortbread. Properly cooked, the eater has Advantage on smell- and taste-based Intelligence and Wisdom checks and on checks with Cook's Utensils for 24 hours; overcooking ruins it.

magic-item:mirrorlight-edge.description: As a Magic action it creates up to two lingering ghostly projections of itself (sheathing hides them). While it has one, after a miss you can dismiss a projection to reroll the d20; each hit deals an extra 1d4 Slashing damage per projection. It sheds Dim Light 10 feet with one projection, 20 with two.

magic-item:mirrorlight-piercer.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the Light property. With a free hand, as a Magic action create a projection of it in that hand (same statistics) and make one attack with either; a thrown projection vanishes and reforms in your free hand while you hold the spear. It lasts 1 minute or until dismissed as a Bonus Action or held by another; both shed Bright Light 10 feet and Dim 10 more.

magic-item:mockingblade.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a bard; shortsword
magic-item:mockingblade.description: You're proficient with it while attuned. It has 6 charges, regaining 1d4 + 2 at dawn; after a hit on your turn, as a Bonus Action expend 1 to cast Vicious Mockery at that creature with your DC, the insult appearing on the blade. If the target rolls a 20 on that save, the sword shouts your insecurities (audible 30 feet), giving listeners Advantage on their next attack against you until your next turn, and it can't cast Vicious Mockery for 1d4 days.

magic-item:monocle-of-clarity.description: It has 4 charges, regaining 1d3 + 1 at dawn. As a Magic action expend 1 to activate a filter for up to 1 hour: read any written language (as Comprehend Languages), 60-foot Darkvision, or see Invisible creatures and objects; changing filters or removing it ends the effect.

magic-item:monsterbane-lasher.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 1d4 Slashing damage. Seven runes (Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Poison, Radiant, Thunder) can each be channeled once per dawn on a melee hit for an extra 2d4 damage of that type, several at once if you like.

magic-item:moonswaddled-armor.description: Between dusk and dawn it grants +1 AC, and Hit Dice you spend during a Short Rest after dusk restore their maximum.

magic-item:necrolace.description: It gains a charge (maximum 3; found with 1d3) when you reduce a Small or larger enemy to 0 Hit Points. As a Bonus Action expend charges to take 1d8 Necrotic damage each (ignoring Resistance and Immunity) and have a creature within 30 feet regain twice that; if this drops you to 0 you are Stable and the target regains twice your remaining Hit Points instead.

magic-item:nightstalker-s-kanabo.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the Heavy property and deals an extra 2d8 Psychic damage to Unconscious creatures. On a natural 20, the target makes a DC 16 Constitution save or is Unconscious until the end of your next turn (ended by damage or being shaken; creatures that don't sleep or are immune to Exhaustion succeed). It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dusk; as a Bonus Action expend 1 to cast Invisibility on yourself or Sleep.

magic-item:null-chalk.description: A pouch of 1d4 + 1 sticks. As a Magic action, draw a continuous line up to 50 feet long that lasts 8 hours (ending if broken by a foot or erased over 1 minute; dispelled for 1 minute as a level 6 spell). Magic can't cross it within 20 feet of the surface: targets have Total Cover from magic beyond it, and non-artifact magic items crossing it are mundane for 1 round. The first time each turn a Celestial, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead tries to cross, it makes a DC 16 Charisma save or has Speed 0 until its next turn, is pushed back 10 feet, and takes 2d8 Force damage; on a success it takes half and passes.

magic-item:omenbringer-s-mantle.description: While wearing it you have Necrotic Resistance and fall at 60 feet per round without damage. Cast Find Familiar as a Magic action as a Raven that stays while you're attuned; if it drops to 0 Hit Points it can't return until dusk.

magic-item:orator-s-quill.description: Activated as a Bonus Action with a command word, it floats and writes what you dictate from within 15 feet onto a surface, waiting for new parchment when full; it stops on the command word or after 1 minute idle.

magic-item:otyugh-cloak.description: As a Magic action, send one-way telepathic messages or images to a creature within 60 feet that understands a language, or have its 3-foot eye tendril do a simple task within 5 feet (10 pounds, no attacks or magic items). As a Bonus Action, close your eyes to see through the tendril with 60-foot Darkvision.

magic-item:ouroboros-rapier.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When its damage die rolls an 8, the target takes an extra 1d8 Poison damage. On a natural 20, the target makes a DC 15 Constitution save, taking 3d6 Poison damage and being Poisoned for 1 minute, or half damage only on a success.

magic-item:overshield.description: While held it grants +1 AC beyond its normal bonus, +2 while you have Temporary Hit Points. Once per dawn as a Magic action, gain 1d6 + 8 Temporary Hit Points.

magic-item:pack-of-levibubble-sugarbombs.description: A pack of 5 gums. After chewing one for 1 minute, as a Magic action blow a bubble that gives you Levitate for up to 10 minutes without Concentration, ending if you pop it or the bubble takes damage; or stick it to a creature or loose object within 5 feet (an unwilling creature avoids it with a DC 13 Dexterity save), which levitates without your control. The gum is then nonmagical.

magic-item:pair-of-tiny-violin-rings.description: Rubbing the ringed fingers plays a sad melody; a creature knowing Vicious Mockery can use them as a Somatic component in place of its Verbal one.

magic-item:pearl-of-wisdom-quiver.description: Arrows drawn from it are magical and ignore underwater ranged combat drawbacks until they hit or another creature holds them. Once per dawn, with a command word it makes a pearl lasting 24 hours; its holder can use it to make a Wisdom check or save with Advantage, consuming it.

magic-item:pendant-of-the-tempered-fury.description: While wearing it without armor or a Shield, Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you take is reduced by 3. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; as a Bonus Action expend 1 to wreathe your hands in harmless flame for 1 minute (Bright Light 10 feet, Dim 10 more), letting Unarmed Strikes deal Fire damage plus an extra 1d4 Fire damage.

magic-item:pendant-of-thieves-sight.description: While wearing it you know Thieves' Cant and gain +5 to Intelligence checks to understand ciphers.

magic-item:peppermince-sugarbomb.description: It dissolves over 1 hour; as a Bonus Action crunch it to take 1d6 Piercing damage, and for 1 minute your Piercing or Slashing weapon or Unarmed Strike hits deal an extra 2 damage. Upset Stomach: only one such sugarbomb works at a time; eating another replaces it and forces a DC 13 Constitution save or you're Poisoned for 1 minute.

magic-item:periapt-of-reflection.description: As a Reaction when you fail an Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma save, reroll it and use the new roll. Curse: if a reroll comes up 1, you're cursed until Remove Curse: your nearby reflections become horrifying and you take 1d8 Psychic damage whenever you fail such a save.

magic-item:permanent-parchment.description: As a Bonus Action say "lock" or "unlock": locked, it can't be torn by hand or harmed by fire or water and its ink is fixed (new ink runs off); unlocked it is normal paper, and "clear" erases its ink.

magic-item:petal-dancer-ward.description: A petal cape whose drifting petals change color as a Bonus Action. While wearing it you can cast Druidcraft, and Beasts and Plants have Disadvantage on Opportunity Attacks against you.

magic-item:phase-axe.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the Thrown property (20/60). The first time on your turn a ranged attack with it hits, another creature within 10 feet of the target makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or takes 1d8 Force damage. Within 60 feet, as a Bonus Action it returns to you, phasing through obstacles up to 5 feet thick that aren't lead.

magic-item:phoenix-ammunition.description: A single arrow or bolt bound to its container, with +1 to attack and damage rolls. It deals Fire damage on a hit and reappears in its container at the start of your next turn. As a Bonus Action set it ablaze before firing that turn for an extra 1d6 Fire damage (it burns out beyond 30 feet). If destroyed it returns after 24 hours unless destroyed while nonmagical.

magic-item:pike-of-the-forgotten-legion.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 6 charges, regaining 1d4 + 2 at dusk: Mirror Image, Phantom Steed, or Speak with Dead (1 each), or Spirit Guardians (2), DC 17. Once per turn on a hit, a spectral warrior haunts the non-Undead target, giving it Disadvantage on attacks against you until your next turn. As a Magic action, expend 3 to send a phalanx down a 25-by-50-foot Line: DC 17 Intelligence save (Undead succeed), 3d10 Necrotic plus 3d10 Psychic damage and haunted, or half damage only.

magic-item:plaguebane-mask.description: While wearing it you have Advantage on saves against Poisoned and magical contagions from airborne sources and Resistance to their Poison damage. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dawn; as a Magic action expend 1 to exhale a 15-foot Cone of pollen: DC 15 Constitution save, 2d8 Poison damage and half Speed until the end of its next turn (unless immune to Poisoned), or half damage only.

magic-item:planar-rapier.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Expend 1 on a melee attack to add 5 feet of reach, or right after attacking a target within 5 feet to pierce through and attack a second target 5 feet behind it (within 10 feet of you, no cover from the first). Either way the extended attack deals an extra 2d8 Force damage on a hit.

magic-item:pomade-of-ten-thousand-styles.description: Holds 4 uses, regaining 1d4 at dawn. A use (1 minute) changes your hair's color, style, thickness, and length (up to 1 foot) until your next Long Rest; cut hair turns to dust in 24 hours, and the same change applied daily for 7 days becomes permanent.

magic-item:potion-of-spell-recovery.description: Drinking it restores expended spell slots of levels 1-5 with a combined level up to 1d3 + 3.

magic-item:precipit-the-formless.description: A coral staff from the Plane of Water. While attuned you breathe underwater and ignore deep-water drawbacks; while holding it you have Cold Resistance. It has 15 charges, regaining 1d8 + 7 at dawn. As a Bonus Action change its water state (or as a Reaction for 1 charge when targeted, before the roll). Gas: Resistance to Bludgeoning and Piercing, +10 Speed, equal Fly Speed, move through creatures, Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage; cast Fog Cloud 1, Misty Step 2, Gaseous Form 3, Cloudkill 5, Wind Walk 6; 2 charges as a Magic action lets you and allies within 30 feet Dash as a Bonus Action without provoking until your next turn. Liquid: Resistance to Bludgeoning and Slashing, +10 Speed, equal Swim Speed, walk on liquids, Reaction to redirect a missed melee attack at another creature; cast Create or Destroy Water 1, Blur 2, Mirror Image 2, Water Breathing 3, Control Water 4; 3 charges as a Magic action: chosen enemies within 30 feet make a DC 18 Strength save, 4d8 Bludgeoning and pushed 20 feet, or half. Solid: Resistance to Piercing and Slashing, Speed 5, +3 AC, forced pushes halved, 10 Temporary Hit Points each turn; cast Ray of Frost (free, or 1 at level 5), Ice Storm 4, Cone of Cold 5, Wall of Ice 6 (DC 18, +10); 4 charges as a Magic action: enemies within 30 feet make a DC 18 Constitution save, 4d8 Cold and Speed 0 until their next turn, or half and half Speed. It has 2 minor beneficial and 2 minor detrimental random properties and is destroyed only by 100 years dry on the Plane of Water.

magic-item:prismatic-javelin.description: After a ranged hit it reappears in your hand. Once per dawn as a Magic action, throw it at a point within 120 feet to burst into Bright Light 20 feet (Dim 20 more): chosen creatures in the bright area make a DC 13 Dexterity save, each struck by a random beam (1d6: Fire, Acid, Lightning, Poison, Cold, or two beams) for 2d10 damage per beam on a failure.

magic-item:profane-mask.description: Your words through it are heard as swearing (you don't notice); a Study action and DC 10 Investigation reveal the magic. Verbal components, command words, and real obscenities pass unchanged.

magic-item:purging-dagger.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals an extra 1d4 Radiant damage, 2d4 against Undead. On a natural 20 against Undead, you can leave it lodged: it sheds sunlight (Bright 15 feet, Dim 15 more) and deals 3d4 Radiant damage at the start of each of the target's turns until removed with an action and a DC 16 Athletics check, then returns to you.

magic-item:purity-spear.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a good-aligned creature; spear
magic-item:purity-spear.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While attuned you're immune to Poison damage and Poisoned, have Advantage on Constitution and Wisdom saves against magic, and are immune to curses (existing ones are suppressed). It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn: Detect Evil and Good 1, Purify Food and Drink 1, Calm Emotions 2, Misty Step 2, Dispel Evil and Good 5, Greater Restoration 5 (DC 17), or 1 as a Magic action to heal a touched creature 2d8 + 2 and end Poisoned. After moving 20 feet straight toward a target, a melee hit deals an extra 2d8 Piercing damage.

magic-item:purse-piglet.description: A ceramic piggy bank that animates and imprints on you when fed a coin. It eats up to 1,000 coins per hour, tells you its total when shaken, and gives exact change in any denomination (reluctantly above 10 percent of its hoard). It follows you or designated allies, vanishing to a pocket dimension beyond 30 feet; summon or dismiss it as a Bonus Action with command phrases. It's a Tiny object (AC 10, 5 Hit Points, Bludgeoning Vulnerability) that shatters at 0, scattering coins, and reforms in 1d4 days. Placing it in another extradimensional space destroys both and opens an Astral gate.

magic-item:puzzle-ring-of-vitality-life-.description: You can use Lay On Hands on a creature within 10 feet. As Study actions, solve its three bands in order. DC 5 Investigation: a 30-foot Emanation aura for 1 minute, healing one creature in it 2d6 when created and at the start of each of your turns. DC 10: you and allies there have Necrotic Resistance, Hit Point maximums can't be reduced, and allies at 0 regain 1 Hit Point at the start of their turns. DC 15: Advantage on saves against magic and no damage on successful half-damage saves. The aura ends if you remove the ring or drop to 0; it then recharges after 1 day per band solved (with all three, roll 1d3 to shorten or reset).

magic-item:quagmire-maul.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 10 charges, regaining 1d6 + 4 at dawn. As a Magic action, expend charges to turn a 5-foot-radius circle within 5 feet into swamp for 1 minute (+5 feet radius per extra charge), Difficult Terrain that you ignore while holding it. On the last charge, roll 1d20; on a 1 it dissolves into muck.

magic-item:quake-hammer.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Once per dawn as a Magic action, strike the ground within 5 feet or throw it at a point within 60 feet: creatures in a 10-foot radius make a DC 15 Dexterity save, taking 2d6 Bludgeoning damage and falling Prone, or half damage only.

magic-item:quickdraw.description: A wrist-mounted hand crossbow fired by two linked rings, needing no free hand; reloading takes 1 minute. When loaded, make a ranged attack with it as a Bonus Action, or as a Reaction at the start of your first turn in combat.

magic-item:quicksilver-clay.description: A palm-sized liquid-metal orb you shape mentally as a Magic action while holding it; it reverts when it leaves your hand. Swallowing it is harmless but takes 1d4 days to pass.

magic-item:radiant-defender.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While wielding it, Dodge also grants +2 AC until your next turn; while dodging, as a Reaction when a creature within 5 feet misses you, attack it with an extra 1d8 Radiant damage on a hit, which ends the AC bonus until you Dodge again.

magic-item:reap-and-sew.description: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals Force damage and ignores Loading, firing a bound needle bolt that returns each attack. While attuned you can cast Mending. It has 4 charges, regaining 1d4 at dawn: on a hit against a Large or smaller creature, expend 1 to tether it within 5 feet of a point; moving more than 10 feet away before the end of its next turn forces a DC 15 Strength save or Speed 0. A lost bolt returns after 24 hours. Curse: starting a rest requires a DC 12 Wisdom save or you must craft with needle and thread for 1 hour first.

magic-item:red-claw-s-regalia.description: A dragon-scale robe. While wearing it you tolerate extreme cold, your Constitution increases by 2 (maximum 22), you have Advantage on Constitution saves and Fire Resistance, and you can walk on molten rock unharmed.

magic-item:relentless-bulwark.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a cleric or paladin; shield
magic-item:relentless-bulwark.description: It has 6 charges, regaining 1d4 + 2 at dawn: expend 1 to cast Shield of Faith, and while holding it, as a Reaction expend another to succeed on a failed Concentration save for that spell.

magic-item:retaliating-bloom-shield.description: Once per dusk, as a Reaction when a Large or smaller creature you can see within 5 feet misses you, it sprays pollen: DC 15 Constitution save, 3d10 Poison damage and Poisoned for 1 minute, or half damage only. It resets at dusk or manually over 1 minute.

magic-item:retaliating-shield-of-ink.description: As a Reaction when a Large or smaller creature within 5 feet misses you, spray ink: Dexterity save (DC 13 with squid ink, DC 10 with common ink) or Blinded until the start of its next turn. Three uses per filling (1 minute to refill); other fillings damage it (8 hours to repair). A Study action and DC 12 Investigation reveal how it works.

magic-item:ring-of-anchoring.description: While attuned you breathe underwater and forced movement against you is reduced by 10 feet. Curse: you can't remove it until Remove Curse (or losing the finger); underwater that arm gives Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks, and each time you're submerged make a DC 20 Strength save each minute: failure means Speed 0 and sinking 30 feet per turn, success means half Speed and Disadvantage on attacks with that arm.

magic-item:ring-of-eldritch-ire.description: It has 3 charges, all regained at dusk. As a Bonus Action expend 1 to mark a creature within 60 feet for 1 hour: you gain +1 to attack and damage rolls against it, it takes -1 to saves against your spells, you always know its direction and distance on your plane, and within 60 feet you see it as with Truesight through visual illusions.

magic-item:ring-of-gestures.description: Cast Minor Illusion from it to alter the look of your ringed hand; its gem mimics your latest gesture.

magic-item:ring-of-roses.description: As a Magic action, grow an odorless rose of any color in your hand that turns to dust after 24 hours.

magic-item:ring-of-seething.description: Choose a creature type on attunement (Aberration, Celestial, Dragon, Elemental, Fey, Fiend, or Undead): it glows hot when one is within 60 feet, and you have Advantage on saves against Charmed and Frightened from that type. Curse: you can't remove it until Remove Curse, have Disadvantage on Insight and Charisma checks involving that type, and while such a creature is within 60 feet have Disadvantage on attacks against other types.

magic-item:ring-of-the-fowl-sentinel.description: As a Magic action, tap a non-hostile chicken's beak to Charm it for 8 hours as a silent lookout (AC 10, 1 Hit Point, Speed 0, +3 Perception); when it sees a new Small or larger creature it cries out, audible 150 feet. One at a time; tapping it again ends this quietly.

magic-item:ring-of-the-sandskimmer.description: You leave no footprints in sand and ignore sandy Difficult Terrain.

magic-item:rings-of-fire-ice-stone-and-w.description: Once per dawn, cast the ring's wall in a stationary 10-foot Emanation around you: fire (rare) Wall of Fire DC 15, 20 feet high; ice (very rare) Wall of Ice DC 16, 10 feet high; stone (rare) Wall of Stone DC 15, 10 feet high and 6 inches thick; wind (uncommon) Wind Wall DC 13, 15 feet high.

magic-item:rocborne-hand-ballista.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It uses two pieces of ammunition per shot, deals an extra 1d10 Piercing damage, and screeches audibly to 100 feet. It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn; on a ranged hit against a Huge or smaller creature, expend 1: DC 16 Constitution save or Speed 0 and no Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.

magic-item:rocborne-robe.description: While wearing it you tolerate extreme cold. It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn; as a Magic action expend 1 to unfurl wings: Medium or smaller creatures in a 15-foot-wide, 10-foot-long Line make a DC 13 Strength save or are pushed 10 feet, and you fly 10 feet backward without provoking.

magic-item:rocborne-rod.description: It has 5 charges, regaining 1d4 + 1 at dawn. Expend 1 (Reaction while falling or Magic action) to sprout wings slowing your fall to 10 feet per round (20 if over 200 pounds), gliding at 40 feet without rising, landing unharmed. As a Magic action, expend 1 for a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high updraft within 5 feet: Large or smaller creatures make a DC 15 Strength save or are launched 30 feet up and fall, as are objects under 200 pounds; you can fail willingly and with wings out rise 60 feet.

magic-item:runic-ammunition.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this ammunition; a concentrating creature it hits has Disadvantage on the Concentration save. It becomes nonmagical after hitting.

magic-item:sandstorm-dancer.description: It has 8 charges, regaining 1d6 + 2 at dawn: cast Create or Destroy Water (1), Blur (2), Call Lightning (3), or Hallucinatory Terrain (4), DC 15.

magic-item:scholar-s-cap.description: Grants a bonus to Intelligence checks and saves and extra research progress for every 5 days of study: uncommon +1 and 1 day, rare +2 and 2 days, very rare +3 and 3 days.

magic-item:scorching-cleaver.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has 8 charges, regaining 1d6 + 2 at dawn and 3 on a natural 20; with any charge it deals an extra 1d6 Fire damage. As a Magic action, expend 3 or more for a 5-by-30-foot Line of fire: Dexterity save (DC 8 + Proficiency Bonus + charges spent) or 1d6 Fire damage per charge. Spending 4+ to empty it overheats it for an extra 3d6, with half damage on a success.

magic-item:screaming-longbow.description: Its shrieking arrows (audible 100 feet) deal an extra 2d4 Thunder damage. On a natural 20, the target and creatures within 5 feet make a DC 15 Constitution save or are Deafened for 1 minute.

magic-item:sea-serpent-hairpin.description: While you're submerged or swimming, creatures you grapple have Disadvantage on checks and saves to escape.

magic-item:seafarer-s-jacket.description: While wearing it you have a Swim Speed equal to your Speed and proficiency (or Expertise) with Navigator's Tools. Once per dawn, cast Fog Cloud (level 2 version).

magic-item:seat-belt.description: Standing on solid ground, as a Bonus Action summon an Invisible chair of any style beneath you as you sit (up to 500 pounds), vanishing when you rise or leave solid ground.

magic-item:seed-of-rebirth.attunementNote: Up to four creatures attune together
magic-item:seed-of-rebirth.description: Up to four creatures attune over a Long Rest and plant it together; it grows in 7 days into a 60-foot magical tree with one great limb per creature. Their attunement survives distance and death but ends on a malicious act against nature. When an attuned creature has been dead 1 minute, its body becomes enriched soil (as Plant Growth) and its soul goes to the tree, which drops a nut 1d6 + 1 days later holding it reincarnated (as Reincarnate), ending its attunement and withering its limb. Attuned creatures sense attacks on the tree; when all limbs die it releases a new seed to another plane.

magic-item:septum-ring-of-the-great-mino.description: Worn as a nose piercing, it raises your Strength by 2 (maximum 22), grants Advantage on Strength checks, doubles your carrying capacity, and lets you perfectly recall paths traveled in the past 24 hours.

magic-item:serpent-dart.description: Once per dawn, as a Bonus Action coat it in poison for 1 minute; the next creature it hits makes a DC 13 Constitution save or takes an extra 2d8 Poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 minute.

magic-item:servitude-choker.description: As a Magic action, wrap it around an unattended nonmagical Small or smaller object under 50 pounds to animate it as a mindless servant (AC 10, Speed 20) for up to 8 hours or until it takes damage; it then can't be used for 1d8 hours. As a Bonus Action within 60 feet, command it to do simple chores (10 pounds, no attacks or magic items, nothing dangerous or beyond 60 feet).

magic-item:set-of-numat-s-trick-tubes.description: Two linked tubes; an object up to 2 pounds sealed in one teleports to the other if both are closed and on the same plane. Creatures can't be sent.

magic-item:set-of-secret-scribe-candles.description: Two linked candles that never ignite paper. Lighting one alone gives a blue flame that burns the nonmagical ink off a page held over it; when it's put out, the other lights with an unquenchable orange flame that transcribes that ink onto a blank page over 1 minute, then goes out.

magic-item:shadow-drinker.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. On a melee hit against a Small or larger enemy, absorb its shadow: for up to 10 minutes a haze surrounds you, making you Invisible while entirely in Dim Light or Darkness, and the dagger deals an extra 1d6 Psychic damage (2d6 against the shadowless creature). The haze ends after you attack, deal damage, or cast a spell, or as a Bonus Action, returning the shadow; once per creature per dusk. Curse: you have Radiant Vulnerability until Remove Curse.

magic-item:shadow-ink.description: A bottle filling 50 pages; its marks glow softly and can be read only in total darkness. Detect Magic reveals only faint magic.

magic-item:shadow-ward.description: While wearing it you have Advantage on Stealth checks. It has 3 charges, regaining 1d3 at dusk; as a Reaction when hit by an attack roll, expend 1 to halve the damage and teleport up to 30 feet to a space you can see.

magic-item:shadowshawl.description: With the hood up your face is hidden in magical Darkness you see through, you gain 60-foot Darkvision (or +60 feet), and light-based effects can't Blind you.

magic-item:shadowsmoke-dragon-pipe.description: It has 4 charges, regaining 1d3 + 1 at dawn. As a Magic action expend 1 to blow a smoke ring at yourself or an ally within 30 feet: it turns Invisible now, or wears the ring for up to 1 minute and turns Invisible as a Bonus Action later; the invisibility lasts until its next turn or until it attacks, deals damage, or casts.

magic-item:shaedenstaff.attunementNote: Requires attunement by a sorcerer, warlock, or wizard
magic-item:shaedenstaff.description: Carved from an undead horn; usable as a magic quarterstaff, and while attuned you have Advantage on saves against mental stress. It has 15 charges, regaining 2d6 + 3 at dusk (on the last, roll 1d20; on a 1 it disintegrates screaming). On a melee hit expend 1 for an extra 1d10 Necrotic damage, or cast Calm Emotions 1, Darkness 2, Inflict Wounds (level 3 version) 3, Dispel Evil and Good 5, or Circle of Death 6 with your DC.

magic-item:shape-shifter-s-circlet.description: Massaging your head for 1 minute gives you one cosmetic feature at a time: another creature's ears, horns or antlers, or altered eyes, until dismissed as a Bonus Action, removed, or you're Unconscious. No senses or abilities are gained.

magic-item:shared-burden.description: Pact chains usable as a focus for warlock spells. When a warlock spell damages a creature, you can add your Charisma modifier (minimum 1) to the damage and take Psychic damage equal to half that (rounded up), ignoring Resistance and Immunity.

magic-item:sharkrazor-mantle.description: While wearing it you have a 60-foot Swim Speed and breathe underwater. A creature touching you that Grapples or Restrains you takes 1d6 Piercing damage then and at the start of each of its turns. You have Advantage on Perception and Survival checks to find or track wounded creatures, and Invisible targets missing Hit Points don't impose Disadvantage on your attacks.

magic-item:sheer-cold.description: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It deals Cold damage instead of Slashing. On a natural 20, ice covers a 15-foot Cone or 30-by-5-foot Line toward the target for 1 minute (Difficult Terrain; DC 10 Dexterity save on entering or starting a turn there or fall Prone), and the target makes a DC 15 Dexterity save or is Restrained until your next turn (DC 15 Strength check as an action to escape).

magic-item:shield-of-yggdrasil.description: Requires Strength 17. While wielded it grants +1 AC beyond its normal bonus. As a Bonus Action plant it for Half Cover against ranged attacks from the front; your Speed becomes 5 and weapon and Unarmed Strike damage you take is reduced by 3 until you uproot it (Utilize action). Planting it with a Magic action leaves it standing as cover for anyone behind it (knocked over by a DC 20 Athletics check). It has 3 charges, all regained at dawn; when planted or later as a Bonus Action, expend 1 to spread metal roots in a 10-foot Emanation that is Difficult Terrain for enemies only.
